result.instructions: Tools for Gripp, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects are not archived yet, and who is the account manager of each?"; "List all unpaid invoices and the open amount per company."; "How many hours did we register on the Acme website project this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gripp data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gripp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gripp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gripp_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. gripp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gripp_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies in Gripp. Companies (customers, suppliers, prospects) with address, VAT/COC numbers, customer number and active flag. Supports filters, paging (max 250 per call) and ordering. Gripp API: company.get.

filters.description: Optional filters, all combined with AND. Custom fields cannot be filtered.

field.description: Full field name, for example project.archived or hour.date.

operator.description: Comparison operator. 'like' uses SQL wildcards, for example %Acme%.

value.description: Value to compare. Use an array for in/notin.

order_by.description: Field to sort by, for example company.id. Default: id.

tools.name: gripp_get_record
tools.title: Get one record
tools.description: Get one Gripp record by its numeric id, for companies, contacts, projects, tasks, hours, invoices, offers, employees or invoice lines. Gripp API: <entity>.getone.

id.description: The numeric id (from a gripp_list_* tool).

tools.name: gripp_list_invoice_lines
tools.title: List invoice lines
tools.description: List invoice lines (description, amount, price, VAT) for one invoice id. Use this to see what an invoice contains. Gripp API: invoiceline.get.

tools.name: gripp_create_hour
tools.title: Register hours
tools.description: WRITE: register hours on a project (and optionally a task) in Gripp. Creates a new time registration each call; a repeat creates a duplicate. Status CONCEPT keeps it editable. Gripp API: hour.create.

offerprojectbase.description: The project id (from gripp_list_projects) the hours belong to.

tools.name: gripp_create_task

company.description: Company id the task belongs to (from gripp_list_companies).
